title: apiScreenshot
responsibility: Selects an attested recorded page capture, verifies its hash and saves its original bytes and provenance.

inputs.name: apiScreenshot.client
inputs.description: Required connected Harness API client supplying the selected snapshot, evidence and bound artifact bytes.

inputs.name: apiScreenshot.entityId
inputs.description: Required registered entity identifier whose recorded screenshot is selected.

inputs.name: apiScreenshot.options
inputs.description: Required selection options. output must name a new file. Optional viewport, state and scenario default to omitted selectors; side defaults to after. Explicit scenario focused admits only passed usable focused captures. An omitted commit selects current evidence; supplied commit selects that historical revision.

outputs.name: apiScreenshot
outputs.type: Promise<{path: string; entityId: string; commit: string; scenario: string; state: string; viewport: string | null; sha256: string; mediaType: string; capturedAt: string; inheritedFrom: string | null; focused: ExplorerCapture["focused"] | null; verification: {record: string | null; status: string | null; standing: string; usable: boolean; note: string}}>
outputs.description: Writes the original hash-verified image bytes to a new output file and returns its absolute path, entity, revision, state, viewport, capture time and provenance. Focused captures retain their focused record identity and have null full-verification status.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Missing output, invalid side, absent or ambiguous capture, missing record binding, SHA-256 mismatch, or a non-image artifact.

errors.name: Transport error
errors.description: Snapshot, evidence and bound artifact requests may reject; client errors propagate.

errors.name: Filesystem error
errors.description: Writing the new file may reject, including an existing output path or insufficient permissions; original bytes are never overwritten.
